verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs say it can personalize responses using "the memory of your past Gemini chats," which is the core of carrying context into new conversations. Notebooks add a continuous chat that remembers sources, instructions and ongoing discussions. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how past-chat memory is chosen and applied in new chats, user controls for viewing or editing remembered context, and independent or hands-on corroboration that cross-chat recall works.
